sanskrit: anantādi śivāntasya śraṣṭāraṃ parameśvaramsarvaśāstra pravaktāraṃ sarvasiddhaistu saṃstutamskandanandigaṇādyaiśca koṭyānekaistu sevitamsiddhavidyādharairyakṣai rākṣasaiśca susaṃstutamapsarogaṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ siddhakanyā susaṃstutamkecit sāmānigāyanti kecit praṇatamūrddhanihasanti kilikilāyanti garjanti cotpatanti caevaṃ pramuditaṃ dṛṣṭvā śivaṃ suravarārcitamkṛtāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā tārkṣyo vacanamavravītpraśnametanmahāguhyaṃ vadabhaktasya me prabhovividhāḥ siddhayaścitrāḥ saṃkṣepā yatra vartaterājyaprasādhanaṃ cānyadartha sādhanameva cayakṣāgrahājvarāghorā lāmā śākinī pūtanābhūtapretapiśācānāṃ nigrahākarṣaṇañcayatmahīpātāla siddhiñca khaḍgamañjanapādukechedanaṃ dahanañcaiva dīkṣā ca vividhā kathamātmānaśca parasyaiva paradeha praveśanamsthāvarāṇāñcarāṇāñca dahanāpyāyanantathākāṣṭhapāṣāṇa bhūtānāṃ sadyāveśaḥ kathaṃ bhavetchedanaṃ paramantrāṇāṃ mātmavidyā prarakṣaṇamkīlanaṃ pararājyasya bhedanaṃ mohanaṃ tathākāmarūpadharatvaṃ ca svacchanda khecare padeetatsarvaṃ samākhyā hi mamabhaktasya śaṅkaratato brahmā samāyāto varaṃ vrūhi mahātapakailāśaṃ gaccha pakṣīśa īśasyaiva samīpataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tato vaikṛṣṭa manasāṃ padmayoneḥ samāgataḥsādhakānāṃ hitārthāya anugraharato bhavaāsīt pūrvaṃ mahāghoraṃ bhairavaṃ rūpamuttamamasaṃkhyātāstvanekāstu raktamāṃsāśavapriyāḥjijñāsārthaṃ mayā tāsāṃ vijñānaṃ yogasambhavamadhiṣṭhastasureśāna carūkāryeṣu maṇḍalepuraṃ vajrārgalantatra rajaiḥ pañcabhirnirmitamvajrāṇi tu caturdikṣu vidikṣu vajra saṃpuṭamtatrāhaṃ karṇikāmadhye sthitaṃ śaktivalotkaṭātāvat kailāśa pṛṣṭhe tu gauryānandi pracoditaḥyoginībhiścarukārye prārthito maṇḍale sthitaḥtvaritaṃ tvaritā vidyā trivījā triguṇīkṛtāsphuradraśmisahasraistu koṭhyānekairdiśo daśahāhāravaṃ prasūcanti trāhi devi śivapriyeprītā sā vividhaiḥ stotraiḥ śiraṣpādādilakṣaṇaiḥaṣṭādaśabhujā devī dharmasiṃhāsanasthitālalajjihvamahogrāsya tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭrasphuranmahatgarjanto balavān bhīmo jvalatkuñcitamūrddhajaḥpūrvānanasthito dīpto grasanniva carācaramdakṣiṇā dviguṇā tasyāḥ pādapṛṣṭhe samarpitāambhojāruṇavarṇābhā padmalāñchanalakṣaṇāsuvṛttaṃ jaṃghapīnoruvistīrṇo jaghanorūmāvistīrṇā kaṭideśe tu hemakumbha payodharāsunāsācāpa bhūbhaṅgā sukarṇā mukuṭojvalānāgarāja kṛto hāra karṇakuṇḍalabhāsinī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mekhalā kaṭideśe tu mahāhi kṛtabhūṣaṇāsahasradale cāmbhoje vāmapāda kṛtodarāmindrāyudhanibhaṃ cānyaṃ vāsaṃ kṛta payodharaukṛtāyudhakarā devī tīkṣṇāgra nakhaśūktayaḥśaraṃ śaktiśca varadaṃ dakṣiṇena kṛtāyudhāabhayaṃ ca tathā padmaṃ vāmapārśva kṛtā yudhāchādayanti svatejobhiḥ śivāghavanigocarātarjayanti diśaḥ sarvāḥ duṣprekṣā durgadevatāḥpatitaṃ śuṣyamānaṃ tu trāhi devisurādhipearcayitvā tu tāṃ devīṃ praṇamitvā tu yoginīmtiṣṭha tiṣṭha mahādīpte atra maṇḍalamadhyataḥpūjitā vividhairmālyairgandhadhūpopahārakaiḥsthāpitā samaye devī yastu smarati sādhakaḥyoginyo bhūcarāstasya sarvakāmārtha siddhidāḥdadāti kāmikāṃ siddhiṃ tvarite tava pūjanātśatravo vilayaṃ yānti iṣṭa satvaparāṅmukhāḥvibhūtayaśca vipulāmārogyaṃ dīrghamāyuṣametasminnantare brahmā merupṛṣṭhaṃ samāgataḥviṣṇunā vāsave nāpi agninā ca yamena caīśānena umādevī siddhairdaityāpsarogaṇaiḥevaṃ karomi deveśa yastu māṃ smarate naraḥbrahmaṇā ca tadā pṛṣṭā vadavidyā prasādhanamtroṭalaṃ tu paraṃ guhyaṃ lakṣaṃ pādādhikaṃ khagavadāmi paramaṃ guhyaṃ śṛṇuṣva kamale'dhunāsā vidyā paramāguhyāguhyānāmapiguhyakā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: marddanī sarvanāgānāṃ ripupakṣa kṣayaṅkarīdivyādivyāstriyo yāstu tāsāṃ kṣobhakarī tu sāhṛdayaṃ sarvadevīnāṃ yoginīnāṃ hṛdisthitāsiddhidā sarvakāryeṣu ihaloke paratra cakalpe kalpe tu ye siddhā muni vidyādharādayaḥekāvidyeśvarī hyeṣā sarvāṃstrāsayate kṣaṇātoṃkārādi svarārabhya yāvadbrahmāṇḍa vācakamtroṭalā tena ākhyātā tantrārthoyaṃ pratiṣṭhitaḥsiddhidā jñānahīnepi gurūyāga vināpi cakurvantyugrāṇi karmāṇi devānāmapi hiṃsakāḥkliśyanti mānavā martye pūrvakarma śubhāśubhaiḥvidyādharatvamicchanti cakravarttitvameva cakhecaratvaṃ jigīṣanti siddhayogeśvaraiḥ saharājyasiddhiṃ prayacchanti dravyasiddhistu kākathāmāraṇoccāṭanaṃ vaśyaṃ chedanaṃ dahanaṃ tathāmohanaṃ sarvaduṣṭānāṃ bhayārtānāñca rakṣaṇamdevīdevaśca garuḍa stritayaṃ tiṣṭhate tanauvāmadakṣiṇa siddhānte tritayeṣu vyavasthitāḥsiddhyate sā tu tvaritā tvaritā tena cocyateityādye troṭale tvaritāmūlasūtre prathamaḥ paṭalaḥsiddhagandharva devānāṃ mṛṣiyakṣa mahoragāmsusame bhūpradeśe tu puṣpaprakara saṃkuleālikhenmātṛkāṃ tatra varga saṃjñā samanvitāmatastvevaṃ prayatnena saṃjñādau kīrtitāmayāprathamaḥ svaravargastu ṣoḍaśākṣaramānataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: prathamaḥ svaravargastu vargādau kīrttito mayācaturthastālu jihvāgro jihvadantastu pañcamaḥūṣmāṇaścāṣṭamaḥ proktaḥ kathitaste khageśvarasarvasiddhikarī devī navabījātmikā parāmātṛkānta vinirgūḍhairguhya bījaiḥ svaraistathāmūlavidyādikaṃ bījaṃ kathitantu khageśvarajihvātālu samāyogo prathamaṃ kavacaṃ bhavetekādaśa svarairyuktaṃ prathamaṃ tāluvargataḥṣoḍaśasvara saṃyuktamūṣmāṇasya tṛtīyakammiśravarga dvitīyaṃ tu adhastāt punareva caūṣmāṇasya dvitīyaṃ tu adhastādviniyojayetpañcamasvaramārūḍhamoṣṭha saṃpuṭa yogataḥprathamaṃ pañcameyojyaṃ svarārddhenoddhṛtā imāoṃkārādi samāyuktā mante namo japetsadāūṣmāṇāntaṃ caturthena svareṇākrānta bindukamṣaṣṭha svarāsanaṃ kuryādvindūnāṃ mūrdhni bhūṣitamakṣaraṃ hṛdayaṃ proktamūṣmāṇaṃ tu dvidhā bhavetṣoḍaśasvara saṃyuktaṃ dvirabhyā sa siro bhavetcaturthasvarasaṃyuktaṃ miśravargadvaye sthitamcaturthena samārūḍhaṃ punarmiśra tṛtīyakampañcamasvarasaṃyukta mūṣmāṇāntaṃ sabindukamatrārūḍhaṃ punastattu punaśvādyaṃ niyojayetmiśrādyena samārūḍha mūṣmāṇasyādimaṃ punaḥūṣmāṇasya dvitīyaṃ tu tāluvargādi saṃyutamdvitīyaścaturthaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥsvarāyojyāḥ krameṇa tu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dakṣiṇaṃ vāmataścorddhve yojyā ca kramataḥ khagacaturdaśe pañcadaśe yojyaṃ miśravarga dvitīyakamtāluvargādvitīyaṃ tu visargeṇa samāyutamcaturakṣaramidamastraṃ phaṭkāreṇa vidarbhitampūrvadakṣiṇa vāruṇyāmuttarāyāṃ niyojayetguhyāṅgāstu ime tārkṣya brahmaṇā gopitāḥ purāgopitavyā prayatnena cā parīkṣyena dāpayetādidvihṛdayaṃ proktaṃ tricatuḥ śiramiṣyatetārakāṃ tu bhavennetraṃ navārddhākṣara rakṣaṇamhūṁlaleti samālikhya vajra tuṇḍe tato bhavetvajratuṇḍā samākhyātā śakradūtī mahāvalākhakheti ca samāyuktā jvālinīnāmabhīṣaṇācarceśavarīmālikhya bhīṣaṇī ca tato bhavetdaśākṣarā samākhyātā yamadūtī mahābalākhagaccheti punaryojyaṃ karālī cograrūpiṇīkṣaḥ śravadravaṃ saṃlikhya plavaṅgī śroṁkṣaḥ uddhṛtāḥstrīcaleti samālikhya kaleti dhūnanī tathāmanovegā imāvidyā vāyudūti mahābalākapilānāma vidyaiṣā daśākṣara samuddhṛtāhūṁ tejovatī raudrī māte hūṁ caiva prakīrttitādaśākṣarā iyaṃ vidyārudradūtī prakīrttitāpharepha saṃyutāhyeṣā viṣṇudūtī mahābalāduṣṭeghuṭṭe samālikhya khaṭṭe ghore ca dustathābrahmavetālinī nāmaghorātīva valotkaṭāatra vidyāḥ sahasrāṇi nirgatāni anekadhā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ayaṃ mantragaṇaḥ siddhastyaja cānyaṃ palālavatityādye troṭale mahātantre tvaritāmūlasūtre dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥtālatrayaṃ saśabdantu tarjanyā tarjayeddiśamūrddhvādho dakṣiṇaṃ vāmā mantrī cāstraṃ samuccaretvinyasya karayormantrī diśāsu vidiśāsu caguhyāṅgaṃ prathamaṃ nyasya hṛdayaṃ kanyase nyasetjyeṣṭhe tu kavacaṃ yojyaṃ netraṃ hastatale nyasetdūtayaśca tathā yojyā jyeṣṭhādārabhya saṃmukhāḥpanastu mūlavidyāṃ tu nakhaśuktiṣu vinyasetpādādārabhya mūrddhāntaṃ śirādārabhya pādayoḥvidyāṅgāni tato nyasya digvastraṃ viniyojayetvatkamaṇḍalamūrddhāntamadhorddhvaṃ cādi bījataḥsavāhyābhyantaraṃ vighnāndhvaṃ sa māyānti tatkṣaṇātnyāsaṃ kuryādyathoktaṃ tu tatontaḥ karaṇa kuruviśantaṃ brahmarandhreṇa sādhakastu vicintayetmūrddhāsya kaṇṭhahṛnnābhau guhyorujānu jaṃghayoḥaṅgulīṣu yathokteṣu vījānyaṅgāni yojayetūrddhva somādadhaḥ padmaṃ śarīraṃ vījavigrahamna mṛtyurnajarātasya na vyādhirna ca hiṃsakāḥpakṣākāro karau kṛtvā choṭhayet pañcabhirnakhaiḥaśvārūḍhā sudīptāśca kumāryobhinna cūcukāḥkhaṅgakheṭakadhāriṇyā svāstramambhojapāṇayaḥnibaddhavarmakakṣāstu bhujagendrottarīyakāḥnyasitvā cādi pādeṣu dvitīyā jaṃghayornyasetpañcamī guhyadeśe tu ṣaṣṭhīnābhau ca vinyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navamī vaktravinyastā daśamī mūrddhni vinyasetjitvā tu pararāṣṭrāṇi akṣatāḥ punarāgametanena vidhinā nyāsaṃ kṛtvā cāṣṭa śataṃ japetityādye troṭale mahātantre tvaritāmūlasūtre tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥmudrābhiḥ sahitāṃ devīṃ tvaritā siddhidā bhavettasmānmudrāṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaika manākhagagranthitau tu karau kṛtvā madhyeṅguṣṭhau nipīḍayetpraṇīteyaṃ samākhyātā hṛddeśetāṃ samānayetniyojya tarjanī madhye mukhalagnā parasparamnābhideśe tu tāṃ vaddhvā aṅguṣṭhāvut kṣipettataḥpunastu pūrvavadvadhvā jyeṣṭhalagnau samutkṣipetubhābhyāṃ caiva hastābhyāṃ maṇivandhe tu vandhayetekā tu madhyamā ūrddhvaṃ śaktireva vidhīyatesaṃmukhāgraṃ sthitā kṛtvā hṛddeśe daṇḍamucyatemadhyamā tarjanī mūrddhva khaṅgasyaivaṃ vidhīyatemadhyamātsuṣiraṃ tāsāṃ pāśamudrā vidhīyatetāryāṅguṣṭhatale kṛtvā tarjanī cālanādhvajaḥadho vāmorddhvadakṣaṃ ca dakṣiṇāṅge niyojayetaṅguṣṭhenā kramettrīṇi triśūlamūrddhvato bhavetvaddhā tu dakṣiṇe muṣṭiṃ kaniṣṭhāṃ tu prasārayetuttānaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ dakṣiṇejānu saṃsthitamvāmaṃ bhujaṃ prasaṃsyārye cakramuṣṭiṃ tu bandhayetvāmena madhyamāṅgulyā tarjanyagraṃ nipīḍayetmuṣṭiṃ vaddhvā tu vāmena hṛddeśetaṃ niveśayetvṛttāstukaraśākhāstu ghaṇṭā bhavati cālanāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāmasya tarjanīrkuñcya ānayet ṣaṣṭhamūlataḥśaṅkhasyaivaṃ bhavenmudrā vāme muṣṭiṃ tu vandhayetvāme tu kiñcidunnāmyakaraśākhāṃ prasārayetadholagnau corddhvaśākhau vṛttākārau tu kārayetpadmasyaivaṃ bhavenmudrā hṛdayetāṃ viniḥkṣipetpraṇītāḥ pañcamudrāstu pūjāhome niyojayetaṣṭāviṃśati mudrāstu kathitāstroṭalottarevajrārgalaṃ samālikhya pūrvalakṣaṇalakṣitāmsitāmbujehyaṣṭadale vinyaset karṇikoparimantreṇānena pakṣīśayojayeccavarāsanampunarghuruguluñcaivagulugarjaṃ punastathāpañcānanaṃ bhaveddevyā āsanamambujopariatrāsane samārūḍhāṃ tvaritāṃ pūjayet khagapañcānanaṃ tu deveśaṃ lakṣaṇena vada prabhotiryagūrddhvagatārekhāścatvāraścaturo bhavetgrāhyā diśā gatāḥ koṣṭā vidiśāstu vināśayetbāhyakoṣṭhasyakoṇeṣu madhye yāvat samānayetvāhyarekhābhavedvajrādvibhaṅgāḥ kārayedbudhaḥkṛṣṇena rajamālikhya kuliśāsita garbhagamdvāreṣu dāpayenmantrī caturovajra saṃpuṭānrajasā pañcavarṇena garbheraktaṃ bhavetpuramvindvaṅkaṃ karṇikā madhye raktena rajasā bhavetteṣāṃ tu vipulā siddhiḥrbhuktiṃ muktiṃ labheddhruvamkālaprāptaṃ tu puruṣamasyamaṇḍalamadhyataḥnaśyanti bhaya saṃtrastā dṛṣṭvā maṇḍalapuṅgavam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: stambhitā mohitāḥ sarve niruddhā vādhyate sukhampūjitā karṇikā madhye pūrvokta kṛta lakṣaṇāmūlavidyāṃ samuccāryamaruddhyomagataṃ khagaevaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ pūjya ekaikaṃ bījamāditaḥnetraṃ madhye dikṣu cāstraṃ guhyamārgeṣu lakṣaṇamdūtayaḥ keśarasthāturvāmadakṣiṇapārśvayoḥlokapālānnyaseccāṣṭau vāhye ca garbhamaṇḍalepañcadaśenanākrāntaṃ svaiḥsvairnāmaistu yojayetvidyāṅgāni ca guhyāṅgāḥ punaḥ piṇḍena yojayettrīnvārān pūjayitvā tu puṣpairgandhaiḥ sugandhibhiḥmāsaiśca vividhākāraiḥrphalairnānāvidhaistathāvastrairvitāna racitaiḥ puṣpaśragdāmaśobhitaiḥmukhapallava saṃchannaiḥ ratnagarbha suśobhitaiḥnavamaṃ yadbhavet kumbhamīśānyā varddhanīyutambherīdundubhinirghoṣaiḥ śaṅkhakāhalanāditaiḥdaśabhāgena cāṅgānāṃ tato homaṃ ca kārayetdvātriṃśadaṅgulaṃ tasya khātanemi vivarjitamdvitri caturbhistāḥ kāryā aṅgulaiḥ svapramāṇataḥnemīnāṃ tu pramāṇena yoniḥ kāryā gajoṣṭhavatucchrāyeṇāṅgulaṃ hyekaṃmagni kuṇḍasya madhyataḥsaptāṅgulā bhavedvīthī śrucā vāhu pramāṇataḥagredviraṅgulaṃ sthaulyaṃ khātamaṅgula nirgamamadha ūrdhvaṃ tu kartavyamājñādhāraṃ khageśvaraṣaḍaṅgulaṃ tu kartavyaṃ veṣṭadaṇḍa pramāṇataḥcaturviṃśāṅgula śruvaṃ khātaṃ gopadapaṅkajam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yonyarddhaṃ tu śrucā kāryā dvātriṃśāṅguladairghyakamgajoṣṭhā kṛtiḥ sā kāryā agnikuṇḍasyamānataḥmūlavidyā parāśaktistasya madhye vicintayethṛdayena śataṃ hyekaṃ guhyāṅgairjanayecchikhimhomayen mūlamantreṇa śataṃ cāṅgā daśāṃśataḥastreṇa tāḍanaṃ kṛtvā guhyāṅgāni tato nyasetgranthiṣu caiva sarveṣu tataḥ puṣpaṃ kṣipāpayettilaiḥ puṣpairasairyuktairghṛtamiśraistu homayetsthāvaratvaṃ purā homaṃ sarīsṛpantataḥ paramviṣṇutvañcaiva rudratvaṃ mante pūrṇāhutirbhavetadhikāro bhavedevaṃ mokṣaṃ śṛṇu ataḥ parampare ca homayetkhasthaḥ karmekarme śataṃ śatammokṣaṃ yāti paraṃ sthānaṃ yaṃ gatvā na nivartatetathāni yujyate dehe vyāpakaḥ paramaḥ śivaḥsṛṣṭi saṃhārakartā ca sakalo niṣkalaḥ śivaḥtāsāṃ madhye bhavenmokṣaḥ pūrṇāhuti niyogataḥiḍayā saumyakarmāṇi piṅgalā krūrakarmakṛtsaṃdhyāṃ vijñāya yatnena sarvasiddhistu sādhayetabhiṣekaṃ tataḥ pañcātkumbhaiḥ pūrvokta lakṣaṇaiḥalakṣmīnāśanaṃ hyetadbhāgyārohaṇameva castrīṇāṃ sahasramadhye tu mahādevī padaṃ labhetvisarjayet tato devīṃ maṇḍalaṃ copasaṃharetdāpayettasya śeṣaṃ tu homayitvā vidhānataḥnavamī śuklā kṛṣṇādve caitrasyāśvayujasya caraktādurliptadehastu kaṇṭhamātretha cāviśet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahiṣājā viraktena nāreṇātha mahāmatiḥvastraśobhairanekaistu gītavāditraniḥsvanaiḥdiśāsu vidiśāsvevaṃmagni kuṇḍāni kārayetardharātragate mantrīte naraktena prokṣayetastrāṇi ca vicitrāṇi aśeṣāntaḥ puraṃ tathāmahāhaṣe praviṣṭānāṃ svayaṃ devī prarakṣatitataḥ prabhātasamaye pūjaye"cca svaśaktitaḥdīnānāthāṅga vikalān vālavṛddha tapasvinaḥpūjopayogaṃ yatkiñciddāpayet svadhikāriṇeukte samudraparyantaṃ tāmusapannamaṇḍukāmtilānmadhughṛtaṃ kṣīraṃ tathā phalmuṣameva cakaravīja javājātī bhakṣyāṇi vividhāni cajapet sahasramekaṃ tu pūjāṃ kṛtvā dine dinesmaraṇā trīṇi kālāni guṇaiśvaryaṃ prajāyatenityamaṣṭaśataṃ jāpyaṃmabhiyukto yadi smaretpūjāṃ kṛtvā dine vāpi caikakālaṃ smaredyadiāhutya pañca saptāṣṭā nava vā daśa vā bhavettilājya pūrahomena śatamarddha tribhāgataḥdadāti vipulān bhogān yadanyaṃ ca samīhatesarvaśāstreṣu hṛdbhūtā siddhānte vāmadakṣiṇesiddhyate nātra saṃdehaḥ sarvāvasthāṃ na saṃśayaḥsiddhyanti mantriṇaḥ kṣipraṃ tvaritāyāḥ prapūjanāttrasanti bhairavāḥ sarve caṇḍogrābhīmavikramāḥsarvajñānamayī vidyā sarvatejomayī śubhāatra sākṣācchivaḥ śūkṣmaḥ sadāśiva umāpatiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tejaḥ piṇḍe sthitaḥ sūryaḥ sarveṣāṃ tejaḥ śaktayaḥbhairavāścograrūpāstu bhairavyo yogamātaraḥguhyakāḥ kinnarā dūtīlāmā śākinī pūtanābūtapretapiśācāścagaṇāhyatra vyavasthitāḥdaityā vidyādharāścaiva somagrahātatārakāḥdurgā umā saratyo lakṣmīḥ kātyāyanīti sānityā yogeśvarī caiva catuṣke navake sthitāḥraktā ca carccikā vidyā pecikā ca karālinībrāhmī māheśvarī caiva kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathāvāruṇī ca mahāyakṣī rākṣasī vīranāyikāabhinandā sunandā ca nandā bhramaravāsinīmahāmāyā svadhā svāhā jvālā coṣmāśriyākalātrailokyamātā viśveśī jagaddhātrī parāparāpañcabhūtātmikā sā tu pṛthivī kaṭhine sthitāvāyutatve calārūpā sarvaṃ vyāpayate kṣaṇātvāgvādi karmatatvasthāṣuddhistanmātrakesthitāprakṛtiḥ śivatatvasthā anantādi śivātmikāevaṃ bhagavatī devī sarvagā sarvasiddhidātvatpriyārthaṃ mayā'khyātā samayaghnenadāpayetdevasvañca gurusvañca dravyaṃ caṇḍeśvarasya caanāthāyāḥ striyā dravyaṃ gaṇikāṣāśca varjayetśivayogī ca yoginyo asaṃpūjya na bhuñjayetna teṣāṃ kārayedduḥkhaṃ dravyaṃ naivāpahārayetjñānine duḥkha saṃtāpaṃ nāhatyādvinivarttatevāmadakṣiṇa siddhānte mantro naiva prasiddhyati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: devāgni yāgarahitaṃ na paśuṃghātayet kvacitna tarkaśāstra dagdhānāṃ śaṭhāya piśunāya caetebhyaśca na dātavyaṃ troṭalaṃ tantramuttamamsudīkṣitobhiṣiktaśca gurorājñā pracoditaḥjapenmantravaraṃ vīrogurūṃ pūjyasvaśaktitaḥityādye troṭale mahātantre tvaritāmūlasūtre pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥgirikandaradurgeṣu guhākoṭaranirddharesmaśāne vā mahāghore padmakhaṇḍe samīpataḥkṣīravṛkṣa samākīrṇe yatra vāramate manaḥpūvottaraplavā bhūmistatracālambhanaṃ bhavetśatāṣṭottara digbhāge nikhanedadharottareanyathā tu japenmantrī vighnānekaiḥ pravādhyatedivyādivyāścaye vighnāścaurarājajanodbhavāḥjapenniḥśaṅkacittastu sarvakāmān prajāyatelolībhūtamidaṃ kṛtvā siddhyate nātrasaṃśayaḥtāṃ dṛṣṭvā paramāṃ jyotsnāṃ divyajñānaṃ pravarttatedviguṇena bhavedrājyaṃ guṇaiśvarya samanvitamtayā sahamahāvīraḥ krīḍate kalpamuttamampañcaguṇena viṣṇutvaṃ prāpyate vaidhruvaṃ padamtatsamaḥ khecaro bhūtvā krīḍate bhuvane prabhuḥjaptvā cāṣṭa guṇāṃ vidyāṃ yāti devaṃ sadāśivamdharmādharma vinirmuktā mokṣaṃ yāti parāparamyāṃ jñātvā caiva japtvā ca na bhūyo janmatāṃ vrajetekavīrā mahāvīryā eka eva hi siddhidāsakṛduccāritā vidyā viṇmūtrādyairvimucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vidyeśa śatajaptvā tu sarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhetmahāpātaka yuktātmā lakṣaṇaiḥ kena mucyatetrailokyaṃ sakalaṃ hatvā sa devāsuramānuṣānvidhinā navalakṣāṇi japtvā sādhaka puṅgavaḥpratimā hematāro vā ratna muktā pravālajāagarūṃ devadārūṃ vā pūrvalakṣaṇalakṣitampaṭe vā likhitā devī kumārī karttitena tusmaśānavastre vā likhya ekahastaṃ svamānataḥsahasraṃ caiva vidyāyā homayitvānyasettanauputrañjīvaka rudrākṣaistārahemakṛtetha vākumārīkarttite sūtre navatantu kṛtena tuśataṃ sahasramayutaṃñjapeddhomaṃ prakīrtitamevaṃ vidhānatāṃ japtvā lakṣamekaṃ homayettilairyavaistathā lājairvrīhigodhūmakāṅgujaiḥarddharātre tu sannaddhaḥ khaḍgakheṭakadhāriṇaḥekavāso vicitreṇa raktapītasitena vānābhimālipta dehastu kṛṣṇā guru sudhūpitaḥbhūṣito hemaratnādyaistāmbūla mukhapūritaḥsarvāṅgopakaraṇādyaiḥ pūjya devīṃ svake gṛhevrajoddakṣiṇadigbhāgaṃ dvāridadyādvaliṃ budhaḥcatvare eka vṛkṣeṣu śaṅkusthāne smaśānakeekaṃ kṛtvā tono mantrī kṣipramāgamanaṃ kuruyogibhiḥ sahamelāpaṃ bhavate nātra saṃśayaḥtadā divya parijñānaṃ bhavate sādhakasya tusatvādhiko mahātejo manovegaśca jāyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhuṅktesau pṛthivī sarvānanivāryā surairapiprāvṛṣe tu japaṃ kuryān manodvignastu mantriṇaḥlabhate sarvasiddhintu mantrī devyāḥ prasādataḥvidyā prastāravettāraṃ mudrābheda vidastuyaḥvidyā bhedaṃ tu vidanti troṭalaṃ durlabhaṃ paramkarṇāvikarṇayogena ata ūrddhva vibhāgataḥmantrabhedaṃ vijānāti sarvasiddhiphalaṃ labhetśāstreśāstresthitā mantrāḥ prayogāstatra durlabhāḥgopitavyāḥ prayatnena sadyaḥ siddhikarā imeprāṇāpahāraṃ kurvanti prastāraṃ gopayet sadāvivādī piśunastabdhonāstiko nindakaḥ śaṭhaḥśuṣkatarkāvalambī ca prastāraṃ gopayet sadāśrutā mayākhilā devavidyā mudrāstathārcanamprastāreṇa tu ye hīnāste hīnāḥ sarvakarmasuprasādaṃ kurudevaśaprastāraṃ darśasvameutpattiṃ śṛṇu pakṣīśa pūrvasṛṣṭaṃ yathā yathāparā sūkṣmākarā jātā śivatatvaṃ su tejasammāyātatva samāyogāt sṛjecchakti manonmanītatra cāṇḍaṃ samutpannaṃ koṭi yojana māyatamahaṃ vismayamātaḥ kare dhyātvā manonmanīniḥsṛtāḥ śatarudrāstu vajrakāyā mahābalāḥbrahmabrahmeti vadato yugmayugmaṃ vyavasthitāḥpañcāśadakṣarāstatra mātṛkāḥ śaktinirgatāḥbrahmāṇḍaṃ dhāritaṃ taistu tadā tatsthiratāṃ gatāmākṛṣya paramāṃ śaktiṃ munmanatvena yojitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatratvaṃ tārkṣya saṃjāto vajratuṇḍā bhavet sukhamtatra randhra samutpannaṃ mūṣmā jvālaṃ vikāsitamsa rudrodbhavaṃ śabdaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ mujvanalaṃ bhavetevaṃ vedāḥ samākhyātāstatsomaṃ veda sayutambrahmagarbhastu mukulīṃ vedadhvani kṛtodaretasya cāṇḍasya madhye tu kṣīravarṇa dravā sṛtegadāśaṅkhadhara śrīmānnābhe'svujadharodvijaḥsarvajñaṃ sarvakarttāraṃ prabhubhaktaṃ yamavyayamkruddhastu tena śabdena ahaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ ko bhavānpakṣapātena tenaiva nirghāte tu parasparamtayośca yuddhamāpanne vudvuda utthito mahānbrahmā tatra samāsīnaḥ kamalagarbhādviniḥsṛtaḥbrahmā tatra smāsīnaṃstadāviṣṇuḥ sthalīkṛtaḥgaruḍenoddhṛto viṣṇurvahīrandhrādvinirgatamgṛhīta padmamudrāyāstejāṃ piṇḍaṃ mahadbhutamādityasya samutpattistejapiṇḍa samanvitamsaṃsthitāḥ śatarudrāstu svaśaktyā daṇḍadhārakāḥsaṃntaptaṃ raśmibhiḥ sarvaṃ bhuvanāśeṣa gocaramīśvareṇa tadā vaddhā karālī trāsinī mahānna ca khaṇḍa vibhāgena na ca bījāni copitāḥsadāśivaṃ tu pūrveṇa īśvaraṃ tu manonmanīmīśānāntāḥ śivādityāstejaḥ piṇḍavyavasthitāḥtataḥ prāptaṃ jagatsarvaṃ diśāsu vidiśāṣu catroṭaleti samākhyātāṃ tantraṃ paramasiddhidamtasyāḥ karma pravakṣyāmi prastāreṇa yathā sthitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navakoṣṭhā bhavedevaṃ madhyadeśe tu ādimamprastāra kramayogena prayogā nirgatāstumeprastāra kramayogena prayogān yastu vindatitrailokyaṃ sakalaṃ tasya tiṣṭhate pādamūlataḥcakravarttitvamāpnoti siddhiṃ labhati kāmikāmityādye troṭale mahātantre tvaritāmūlasūtre saptamaḥ paṭalaḥprasanno yadi deveśa mama bhaktiñca vindasimanasā sarvakarmāṇi kārayennātra saṃśayaḥtrailokyaṃ sakalaṃ kruddhaṃ kṣaṇāñcaivopa saṃharettataḥ sāmudritā vidyā samayestāpitā punaḥyastu karma vijānāti tasya siddhistu nānyathāpraṇītā pañcabhedena jñātvā siddhyanti tatkṣaṇātkhecaratvañca āyuśca ṣaṣṭhaṃ padamanāmayamanyāśca siddhayaścitrā śṛṇutārkṣya yathā sthitāḥkapāle tu samālikhya śivatatvaṃ samantataḥtasya garbhe likhennāma karṇiko parisaṃsthitamsaptāhādānayet sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sa carācarammadhye tu garbhagannāma sadāśiva vidarbhitammukhastambha gatistambha sainyastambhaśca jāyateśaktyugre vinyased rudraṃ triṣu koṇeṣu caiva hiśmaśāna kharpare likhya kapāle vā suśobhaneviṣaraktena saṃlikhya śmaśāna karpaṭe budhaḥmārayede cirādeṣaḥ śmaśāna nihitaṃ ripumcakradhārāgatāṃ śaktiṃ ripunāma samanvitamtārkṣyeṇaiva tu bījena khaḍgamadhye vilekhayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekānte tu samālikhya tāḍayecciti bhasmanāsādhayennātra sandeho mūḍhaṃ vihvala cetasamrocanā likhitaṃ taptaṃ mānaye dūrvasīṃ kṣaṇātdhvajāmūle tathāgre ca madhyeṣu ca vidarbhayetbhūtavṛkṣe samārūḍhaṃ saptāhoccāṭanaṃ bhavetlikhedrocanayā mantrī tāḍayejjāti kudmalaiḥbhedanamīśadigbhāge śūlāgre tu vidarbhayetdhattūrakarase naiva tāḍayet karavīrakaiḥsvaiḥ svaiḥ karmavibhāgena dūtī vidyāṃ niyojayetaṣṭāmbujeṣu hṛdayaṃ śāntipuṣṭyādikīṃ kriyāmbhedanaṃ chedanaṃñcaiva māraṇeṣu śiro bhavetśikhā strīṇāṃ kapāleṣu arddhacandreṣu vinyasetkavacenāṣṭa kīlāntu kṣīravṛkṣa samudbhavamastreṇa vā vidhānajñaḥ sarvarakṣāṃ tu kārayetkapāle bhūrjapatre ca likhedaṣṭa dalāmbujamānayeddevadaityāstu siddhavidyā dharāstathātrikoṇe tu jvaraṃ dāhaṃ ṣaṭkoṇe chedana māraṇamśāntiñca bhavate kṣipraṃ dhvaje voccāṭanaṃ bhavetśūleṣu devadaivatyānāṃ trāsaṃ kurvanti yoṣitāḥguhyāṅgānāṃ tu yatkarma dūtīnāñcaiva yadbhavettribhāgabhāgabhāgañca praṇītā mudramudritātribhiranyaistu sā vidyā mudrairummudritā khagaprastāreṇa tu sā siddhā anekākāra bhedataḥdahanaṃ śoṣaṇañcaiva jvarañca kurute kṣaṇātchedanaṃ bhedanañcaiva unmanīkaraṇantathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: īśāne tribhire vai tadbhedinī tatra saṃsthitāapasavyena trīṇyevaṃ mastrasaṃghānnipātayetarcanī kramayogena madhye dvitripradakṣiṇānnṛtyanaṃ vapanañcaiva bandhanañca pralāpanamvidyāvyaktamatodbhītā bhedinī vandhanī kṣaṇātkarālī kramasodbhītā tejaḥ piṇḍaṃ mahadbhutamevañcaturbhiḥ sā devī tribhiranyaiḥ khageśvarabhedaṃ caiva tu bījānāṃ mudrā bhedaṃ caturvidhamekākī devadaityāśca yakṣarakṣogaṇānapikṣaṇāddhijjayati saṅgrāme bhuṅkte rājyamakaṇṭakamtatrastho dhārayettaṃ turaṇe dyūte jayo bhavetdhāraṇādasya cakrasya jayate ripusainikamalaktena tu saṃdvannaiḥ kramādvīja stribhistribhiḥnyaset pūrvādi yogena svarāṣṭrasya vidhānataḥāyasāsthimayā vāpi nikhaneddigvidikṣu camantravidyāparairyuktāparacakropaghātanambuddhivīryabalabhraṣṭaṃ manekopadravairyutamsādhayeda cirādeva mahādurga samāśritamyo vijānāti tatvena sabhuṅkte pṛthivītalamkajratuṇḍā samāyuktaṃ manasā mantramuccaretdravādi triprayogoyaṃ karālā mudrayā sahanair-ṛtyādi prayogoyaṃ praṇītā sahayojitaḥvyomāgni yogayuktastu vilomena tadeva tupūrvādi bhedanī vaddhvā daṣṭrikā yā tu kīlanaḥnāgarākṣasa yakṣāṃścapiśācān bhūtasākinīm
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śakaṭādyātmahāyantrān sambhayet potakānapiīśānādi prayogoyaṃ bhavedinī mudrayā sahasphoṭayet pararāṣṭrāṇi bhagnaṃ kurvanti tatkṣaṇātīśānādyagni yogena karālyā śastrakhātanamuttarādiṣu yogoyaṃ sarvagranthiṃ nivārayetvāyavyādi prayogoyaṃ vajratuṇḍā samanvitaḥyaṣṭyupānahacchatre vā yojitoṣṭa śataṃ khaganair-ṛtyādi calāntaṃ tu nāgākarṣaṇa kārakamāgacchati kṣaṇādeva arthadā kāmadā bhavetdahanādi prayogoyaṃ śākinīkarṣayet kṣaṇātāgnyādi tridalāntaṃ tu karālyā mudrayā japetdīpe vā sarvakāryāṇi pṛṣṭāste kathayanti capraṇītā saṃjñitā hyeṣā kṣaṇānnāśayate grahāncalādidanāntaṃtu triṣu sthāneṣu yojitamśmaśānāṅgārakairlikhya kuḍye vā tāḍayettataḥnair-ṛtyādyantu īśānāṃ vajra tuṇḍāṃ tu bandhayetkāmadāśca bhavantyete sādhakasya na saṃśayaḥkāṣṭhapāṣāṇakāveśaḥ svasthāveśaśca jāyatekuṣṭādyā vyādhayo ye tu nāśayennātra saṃśayaḥrakṣayedātmano vidyāṃ prativādī yadā śivaḥmadhyādi aindraparyantaṃ bhedinī mudrayā sahaāgneyīkhagatāṃ kṛtvā sarvaduṣṭānnipātayetmadhyenāma tu vinyasya jalakoṣa vināśanamśuddhavā'śuddhatāṃ neti kṣaṇānmantrī na saṃśayaḥpūrvādi madhyamāntaṃ tu laghutvaṃ kurute kṣaṇāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: praṇītāṃ vajratuṇḍāñca mudrān tatra niyojayetpātre ca viṣaraktena niyuktā vajramaṇḍaleśuddhopi dahyate tena svayaṃ yadi jalādhipaḥvāruṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ bhūrje gorocana yā samālikhetnikṣipet kumbhamadhye tu divyastambho bhaveddhruvambhūrje rocanayā likhya vajramaṇḍalamaṃ dhyataḥākrāmyadhārayettaṃ tu dyūtejayati mānavaḥvivaradvāramāśritya bhedinī mudrayā japetsantrastā nirgame kṣipraṃ kanyā pātālavāsinīdivyāśraye japenmantrī siddhyate nātra saṃśayaḥsādhakaḥ sthiracittastu akṣatāṅgaśavoparikṣaṇānniṣkamate jihvā khaḍgaścā guṭikātha vāantardhānī bhavet sahijavairbheda sa dṛśyatetaccakṣurañjaneryuktaṃ grahaṇaṃ siddhamañjanambhedinīṃ vandhayen mantrī japedaṣṭaśataṃ tadāagnināḍīniruddhā tu koṣṭhagā vījasaṃyutānirvījīkaraṇaṃ hyetad vṛkṣaṃ śoṣayate kṣaṇātvyomasthaṃ tu japeddhyetajjapāṣṭa śatasaṃkhyayāamṛtaṃ vyomagaṃ kṛtvā tatkṣaṇā'pyāyanaṃ bhavetniruddho marutaḥ saṃcāraḥ pararāṣṭrasya sanmukhamkīlayet stambhayet sarvaṃ niśceṣṭaṃ balavarjitamekayā nirgamo mantrī vajratuṇḍā tu bandhayetbhūtapreta piśācānāṃ daṃṣṭriṇāṃ ca nigraheīśaḥ śaktiḥ khago viṣṇuḥ śivaścaiva sadāśivaḥnāgāgrahāṃstathā meghānānayeṣṭa śatena tu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sadāśivaḥ śivo viṣṇurbrahmatejovidāraṇaḥsvaliṅgasūtra jālena purādyena tu dhūpitamtadābharaṇa rūpeṇa paṭe kanyāvatāraṇambhedanaṃ tejapadmorthaṃ viṣṇuḥ śivaḥ sadāśivaḥsiddhyate caiva saptāhājjaptvāṣṭaśatasaṃkhyayābhūtaṃ bhavyaṃñca yatkiñcidvarttamānañca yadbhavetsadāśivaḥ śivoviṣṇuḥ suparṇaḥ śaktirīśvaraḥmarutkoṣṭha samāruddhaṃ yatpuṣpaṃ hṛdi cintayetpatraṃ puṣpaṃ halaṃ bhakṣyaṃ mānayennātrasaṃśayaḥdarśayen mantrasiddhiṃ tu varabhogyāṃ tu mantriṇedhārayet preṣayedanyaṃ bhedanyāṃ khagarudgataḥpreṣayitvā nilaṃvyome praṇītāṃ guhyadeśataḥnāmasthā na diśaṃ jātivarṇarūpaṃ vayastathāpreṣaṇe vyomagāṃ kṛtvā ātmasthañcaivakarṣaṇevāruṇemaṇe madhyage aindra īśasaumya ca vāyavevyomagastu japedvīraḥ ruttiṣṭhennātra saṃśayaḥkāmarūpadharaḥ śrīmān svacchandaḥ śaktidīpitaḥvisuvena tu ruddhena karālyā mayutaṃ smaretāpyākāśaṃ sthitaṃ dīptaṃ yāmyāṃ rakṣo diśādhipamsañcitya hṛdaye kārya vajratuṇḍā niyogataḥsvapneṣu dṛśyate sarvaṃ yatkāryaṃ hṛdi saṃsthitamrākṣasaṃ dravasāmīraṃ saumyaṃ śivamanonmanīśatrūṇāṃ duṣṭa satvānāṃ te lakṣaṃ kurute sadāśatrūnvijayate sarvānte lakṣāścaiva mohitānṣaḍetābhirjapenmantrī bhedinī nābhiyojitā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kuṣṭhādīnāṃ tu vyādhīnāṃ pāpānāñcaiva nāśanamekayā vajratuṇḍā tu astu sanmukhamāgatamyāmyavyomyottaradale vāyavye cāpare khagaśākinī grahavetālā bhūtāḥ pretāśca rākṣasāḥānayet pārśvato mantrīkṛtakāryaṃ vimokṣayetṣaḍguṇāhomite mantrī samahometha gocaraḥuttaraṃ vyomagaṃ yāmyamagnigaṃ pūrvamīśagamānayedurvaśīñcāpi dahyamānāṃ na saṃśayaḥyogayukto yadā mantrī siddhārthe śatahomataḥuttaraṃ vyomagaṃ śaktirgaruḍo viṣṇupadmajamvidveṣayetkṣaṇādevaṃ kāmadeva samaḥ priyaḥitistu saptabhirbījaiḥ rakṣatāṅgaṃ salakṣaṇamvajrārgalapurasthaṃ tu śatamaṣṭottarañjapetāruhya śavavaktre tu kṣīraṃ bhuktvā vrajettataḥdevāgni guruve datvā sahāyyebhyaśca sādhakaḥtacchavamakṣayaṃ divyaṃñjātarūpamayaṃ bhavetvyutkramāt khecaro mantrī vajratuṇḍāllabhedasimrakṣadravamaruttejo bhedanaṃ pṛthivī śiraṣīuttiṣṭhanti na sandehaḥ kare gṛhyatadotpatetyasya devasya yatproktaṃ tadārūhya jayo bhavetsiddhyate tatpuraṃ tasya yasya devasya vāhanamparāstra mālabhenmantrītamāruhya samutpatetmarutkoṣṭha samopetānmānayen mṛgapakṣiṇaḥekāṃ vai vā likhet kanyāṃgairikārocanātha vāpraṇītāṃ kanyasāṃ vāmā ūrddhvāṃ kṛtvā supīḍitām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vihvalā tatkṣaṇādeva niḥśaṅkā mūḍhacetasādakṣiṇāṃ kanyasāṃ pīḍya dakṣiṇena kramedvṛtibrahmāviṣṇuḥ suparṇaśca śaktirīśaḥ sadāśivaḥsvaliṅgasūtranāryāyāḥ prathamaṃ taddine budhaḥniśācaro yadā mantrī niśāyāṃ sādhanaṃ bhavetśyāmākataṇḍulāndatvā pāpaṃ saṃsādhayet khagautpatet tatkṣaṇādeva svacchandaṃ krīḍate khagayadyaccintayate dravyaṃ tattadānayate kṣaṇātrudraḥ sadāśivaḥścāṣṭau karālīhyagni yogataḥtrisandhyaṃ tridinañcaiva cakravartti samaṃ nṛpambhedanamaindrañca chedanaṃ rākṣasādhipamnīlārdra paṭamāvṛtya karālyā sahitañjapetśmaśānakarpaṭemantrī śaktibhinnamadhorddhvataḥdakṣiṇenāgni mārgasthaṃ paṭoyāṣadviśuṣyatijalārdraṃ triguṇe naiva brahmāviṣṇurumādayaḥsadāśiveśaśaktiścaśca suparṇo viṣṇupadmajaḥvyāpayet sakalaṃ viśvaṃ vāyunāvyomagena tunāsāgne tu parānāḍī indragopakarānnibhāgatvā somapuraṃ yāvajjapen mantraśataṃ budhaḥlakṣaṇādvaktra madhye tu amṛtaṃ karṣayet mukhamkramāt kramādidaṃ yogaṃmabhyasennityameva cacakravarttitvamāpnoti mahākalpāyuṣo bhavetsarkarāṣṭā tathā cāṣṭau ekaikaṃ tu śanaiḥ śatamjapedvyaṣṭaśataṃ mantrī aṣṭabījaistadeva tuāsutṛṇajalaukāśca śalabhāyāḥ sarīsṛpāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcānanaṃ śilāpaṭṭe vajrasaṃpuṭalāñchitamśmaśānāṅgāralikhitaṃ tālakena samanvitamvolomā tvaritāṃ likhyabhedanaṃ karṇikopariveṣṭayeccakravegā yā brahmavetālinī punaḥdūtikāṣṭau samālikhya garbhe tu catusrakebhedanañcakravegāyā madhye yojyaṃ khageśvaradakṣiṇe kavacaṃ lekhyaṃ netraṃ paścimadiggatampūrvapaścimadiktaṃsthaṃ dakṣiṇottaradiggatampūrvāgre vajratuṇḍā tu śabarī caiva dakṣiṇeīśāgnistha vajrasya yā rekhā tu vinirgatākarālīṃ tu samālikhya nair-ṛtyāṃ vāyavottagāraudrīntatra samālikhya viparītākṣarairbudhaḥdvitīye tu śilāpṛṣṭhe punareva samālikhetlepayitvā tu śiktena pūjayedvidhinā tataḥniḥkṣipejjalamadhye tu bhūmau vāpi nikhātayetstambhayet parasainyāni mohayedbandhayet punaḥvajrārgalena saṃruddhvā bhayatrastāḥ suvihvalāḥśatravaḥ sukhasādhyāśca indratulyā mahābalāḥmanastambhaṃ vaktrastambhaṃ gatistambhaṃ bhaveddhruvamyo jānāti khageśedaṃ sa ripuṃ vijayiṣyatighaṭāgnyāyaviṣaṃ koṣaṃ stambhayennātra saṃśayaḥkramākṣare niyuktā tu vidyā pañcānane pureśikhipittena vā likhya śuddhañcā śuddhatāṃ nayettatra smairmantrabījaistu rakṣāṃ dehe tu kārayetakālamṛttyu dahanīrājopadravanāśanī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daṃṣṭriṇāñcaripūnāñca dhvaṃsanī tu surakṣiṇīsaubhāgyakaraṇī nityaṃ dhāryā khageśvaravandhyānāṃ putradāhyeṣāsau bhāgyakaraṇī bhavetsādhayet sarvakramāṇi vidhiṃ vijñāya tattvataḥpunastu dūtyāvaraṇaṃ tato mantrāstu siddhidāḥpañcānanapure vidyāṃ pañcabhāgena cālikhetyatra mākramate tena tataḥ kṣipraṃ prasiddhyatimudrāstu caiva saṃyojya tataḥ karmāṇi kārayetvāmayā caiva saṃyojya śavarī ca karālinīkapilā caiva raudrī ca cakravegā tṛtīyakāvajratuṇḍā jvālinī ca vajratuṇḍe niyojayetplavaṅgī manovegā ca praṇīt mayāṃ niyojayetcakravegā sa bījānāṃ brahmavetālinīṃ nyasetsannaddhaṃ pañcamudrābhiḥ stvaritā bhedaniścayaḥsādhayet sarvatsiddhīniyogahīnopi sādhakaḥprathamaṃ brahmarandhre tu śatañvāraṃ niyojayetsomaṃ dvibhiḥ susaṃruddhaṃ sūryamekena rodhayetdehasthaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva ātmasthena pareṇa tugacchate pahnanālena vāyunā caiva niṣkrametādau pretasya kartavyaṃ karmacaitatkhageśvarabhedanyā bhedayedvāyuṃviśet parapuraṃ sukhamchinnaṃ bhinnaṃ mahāstraistu nayate yatra rocatebhogāśakta praviṣṭastu krīḍate yāvadrocateanenaiva prayogeṇa śrotraṃ śiṣṇe nirodhayetnirodhaṃ vā gude deśe bhedanaṃ hṛdi vinyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṣaṇenotkramaṇaṃ kṛtvā ātmanaśca parasya vāyaṃ gatvā na nivarteta sarvavyāpī śivo bhavetpunastrikamagnimārge somamārge punastrikamtārakaṃ hṛdaye sthāne yojayecchiṣyadehataḥkṣaṇenotthāpanaṃ kuryād dṛṣṭvā sarvamidaṃ jagatvaddhvā tu bhedinī mudrāṃ recayitvā samīraṇamviśate granthimārge tu bhidyate nātra saṃśayaḥkaṭinābhi hṛdikaṇṭhe vaktre bhūmadhyamūrddhanigranthibhedaṃ tu hṛddeśe yāvat kurvanti mantriṇaḥtālagranthi vibhedena mantriṇaśca khageśvaraudgiret sarvaśāstrāṇi divyā vāṇī pravartatepaśyate bhuvanān sarvānātmanā dehamadhyataḥniṣkalaḥ paramaḥ sūkṣmaḥ pañcabhūta vyavasthitaḥdvipañcaguṇite naiva svacchandaḥ sarvago bhavetmūrddhvā mūrddhni gato vīra ekānte vijanesthitaḥsvarūpeṇa svadehena japet sādhaka puṅgavaḥmudrā mūrddhni gato mantrī praṇītā japamācaretāgacchanti mahāguhyāḥ siddhayogeśvareśvarāḥhṛdaye guhyāṅgāṇāṃ nāmastṛkṣyusya jalena tusiddhiṃ manepsitāt kāmāṁllabhate nātra saṃśayaḥlabdhānujño japenmantraṃ sādhakaśca na saṃśayaḥvajraṃ putraṃ mahāvīra khecaratvaṃ sudurlabhampraṇītāṃ bandhayen mūrddhni daṇḍavadva sudhātaleyāgaṃ kṛtvā tu pūrvoktaṃ darśane darśane sudhīḥmeṣājaṃ mahiṣaṃ nāraṃ lakṣe pūrṇe'gni madhyataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00313 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tataśca hṛṣṛ manasā arghyaṃ dadyāt subhāṣitaḥuktavatī tadā devī sādhuputra mahātapaḥkhecaratvaṃ mahāsiddhiṃ sahāyasahito vrajatejo rāśiṃ mahādīpto vrajate yatra rocateasthi carmāvaśeṣaṃ tu śuṣkapiṇḍāśca dehinaḥtepyardha binduṃ saṃspṛṣṭāstapaḥ śaktyopabṛṃhitāḥdivyārūpadharo bhūtvā trinetra mukuṭojvalākrīḍante sarvalokeṣu śivaśaktyopabṛhitāḥkalauyugepi pakṣīśa siddhidā nātrasaṃśayaḥtīkṣṇā bhayāvahā caṇḍā ugrā saṃkṣipta siddhidātroṭaletantrasāre tu navavījāḥ parāḥ smṛtāḥnavavīja vidhiṃ jñātvā bhedaṃ bhedena bheditamtribhirbījaiśca dvātriṃśaccaturbhiraṣṭa eva tusaptabījairbhavedaṣṭa aṣṭabhiśca turo bhavetdūtībhiścāṣṭa karmāṇi eva maṣṭottaraṃ śatamaṣṭottara karmaśataṃ vastuvindati deśikaḥsādhayet pararāṣṭrāṇi rājyaśca pṛthivī taleyaḥ smarettvaritā vidyāṃ jñānato'jñānatopi vāsasnātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhetyatkiñcidvāṅmayaṃ sarvamaśeṣa bhuvanāntikamyena jñātā parā vidyā sarvagā kāmagā śubhāanyatantre mayā tārkṣya bhrāmitā mantramudrayātroṭalaṃ ye vijānanti bhedabhinnamanekadhāmānuṣāṇāṃ hitārthāya anugraharatā sadāvandhāḥ pūjyāścānumodyāmānyāste nityameva tu
